issues.span: 他和一千二百五十名僧人，組成一個很大的出家人的團體
issues.evidence: The Tibetan/academic text says the Blessed One was gathered with a great community made up of 1,250 monks (the community consists of the monks), not that he and the monks together form the community.
issues.fix: 世尊和一個很大的出家人的團體在一起，這個團體有一千二百五十名僧人。

issues.span: 穿好下身的僧衣和僧衣
issues.evidence: Academic text: put on the lower robe and the outer robe; repeating '僧衣' twice with no contrast is confusing for children (locked terms are kept).
issues.fix: 穿好下身的僧衣，再披上僧衣

issues.span: 不管有多少眾生算在眾生裡，不管是從蛋裡出生……我都要讓他們全都進入不剩組成部分的脫離憂苦境界，讓他們完全脫離憂苦。
issues.evidence: The academic text is one long enumeration; the children's version keeps it as a single very long sentence with stacked 'not matter' clauses, hard for ages 8-12 to follow.
issues.fix: 分成短句，例如：『不管有多少眾生，不管是從蛋裡出生、從母胎出生、從溫濕處出生，還是神奇出生；不管是有形狀的還是沒有形體的；不管是有想法的、沒有想法的，還是非有想法也非無想法的——我都要讓他們全都進入不剩組成部分的脫離憂苦境界。』

issues.span: 因為這樣的人就不叫做菩薩了
issues.evidence: Academic text: 'because he is not called a bodhisattva'. '這樣的人...了' can be read as referring to the person who just had the thought of liberating beings, implying a consequence/reversal; the Tibetan only gives the bare reason, clarified in the next segment (one who holds a notion of being/life/person).
issues.fix: 因為他不會被稱為菩薩。
